title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2607.08642v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting tokens and verifying them in parallel. Block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash model only per-position marginals, and tree methods such as DDTree expand candidate trees from those marginals. The released Domino drafter adds a GRU-based causal correction making each draft token's distribution path-dependent, a structure DDTree's factorized formulation cannot represent. We introduce DominoTree, a training-free best-first draft tree scored by Domino's conditional (non-factorized) correction along each root-to-node path, made practical by restricting the per-node correction to a candidate top-M. We evaluate it on eight benchmarks in a single-stream harness, and in SGLang, where it runs as an out-of-tree plugin against AR, DFlash, EAGLE-3 and Domino under identical flags. translated_title: DominoTree：基于多米诺的条件树状草稿生成用于推测解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.08642v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：推测解码通过草拟令牌并并行验证来加速大语言模型推理。块扩散草稿器（如DFlash）仅建模每个位置的边际分布，而树方法（如DDTree）则从这些边际分布扩展候选树。已发布的Domino草稿器引入了基于GRU的因果校正，使每个草稿令牌的分布具有路径依赖性，这是DDTree的因子化公式无法表示的。我们提出了DominoTree，一种无需训练的基于最佳优先的草稿树，通过Domino的条件（非因子化）校正沿每条根到节点路径进行评分，并通过将每节点校正限制为候选前M项来实现实用性。我们在单流测试框架中对八个基准进行了评估，并在SGLang中作为树外插件与AR、DFlash、EAGLE-3和Domino在相同标志下运行。DominoTree在每个服务单元中均达到最高平均接受长度——涵盖两种模型规模、单请求场景。
tldr: DominoTree通过将Domino的路径依赖条件校正应用于树状草稿生成，实现了无需训练的最高推测解码接受率。
en_tdlr: DominoTree achieves the highest speculative decoding acceptance rate by applying Domino's path-dependent conditional correction to tree-structured drafting without training.
